# Microsoft
> Microsoft provides AI, cloud, productivity, computing, gaming, devices, apps, and support for consumers and businesses.

Microsoft.com is the central entry point to Microsoft's ecosystem, spanning Microsoft 365, Copilot, Windows, Surface, Xbox, Azure, app stores, commerce, and support. It also connects to major Microsoft properties including Azure documentation, Microsoft Learn, support portals, and product-specific sites.

## Core Products
- [Microsoft Homepage](https://www.microsoft.com/): Main portal for Microsoft products, services, devices, subscriptions, and support.
- [Microsoft 365](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/microsoft-365): Productivity subscriptions for individuals, families, and businesses with Office apps and cloud services.
- [Copilot](https://copilot.microsoft.com/): Microsoft's AI assistant for web-based chat, search, and task support.
- [Windows](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows/): Windows product hub for PCs, features, downloads, and device experiences.
- [Surface](https://www.microsoft.com/surface): Surface device family including laptops, tablets, and accessories.
- [Xbox](https://www.xbox.com/): Gaming platform for consoles, Game Pass, cloud gaming, and accessories.
- [OneDrive](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/microsoft-365/onedrive/online-cloud-storage): Cloud file storage and syncing for personal and business use.

## Microsoft 365
- [Microsoft 365 Home](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/microsoft-365): Overview of Microsoft 365 plans, apps, storage, and AI features.
- [Word](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/microsoft-365/word): Word app overview for document creation, editing, and collaboration.
- [Excel](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/microsoft-365/excel): Excel app overview for spreadsheets, analysis, and data visualization.
- [PowerPoint](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/microsoft-365/powerpoint): PowerPoint app overview for presentations and storytelling.
- [Outlook](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/microsoft-365/outlook/email-and-calendar-software-microsoft-outlook): Outlook email and calendar software for personal productivity.
- [OneDrive](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/microsoft-365/onedrive/online-cloud-storage): OneDrive storage, backup, sharing, and file access across devices.
- [Teams](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/microsoft-teams/group-chat-software): Teams collaboration for meetings, chat, calling, and teamwork.

## Windows and Apps
- [Windows Home](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows/): Windows overview with PCs, features, and upgrade information.
- [Windows 11](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows/windows-11): Windows 11 features, productivity tools, and system experience overview.
- [Windows Help & Learning](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows): Official Windows support articles, troubleshooting, and setup guidance.
- [Microsoft Store Apps](https://apps.microsoft.com/home): App marketplace for Windows applications, games, and downloads.
- [Microsoft Edge](https://www.microsoft.com/edge): Microsoft Edge browser with productivity, security, and AI features.
- [PC Game Pass](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/xbox-game-pass/pc-game-pass): PC gaming subscription with access to a rotating game catalog.

## Surface and Devices
- [Surface Home](https://www.microsoft.com/surface): Surface lineup overview for laptops, tablets, and accessories.
- [Surface Pro](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/surface/devices/surface-pro-11th-edition): Surface Pro device page with specs, features, and purchase options.
- [Surface Laptop](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/surface/devices/surface-laptop-7th-edition): Surface Laptop device page with performance and design details.
- [Surface Accessories](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/store/b/surface-accessories): Surface keyboards, pens, docks, and related accessories.
- [Shop Surface](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/store/b/surface): Microsoft Store shopping hub for Surface devices and bundles.
- [Copilot+ PCs](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows/copilot-plus-pcs): AI PC category page for Copilot+ hardware and features.

## Xbox and Gaming
- [Xbox Home](https://www.xbox.com/): Xbox platform overview for consoles, games, subscriptions, and services.
- [Xbox Game Pass](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/xbox-game-pass): Subscription service for console, PC, and cloud gaming access.
- [Xbox Cloud Gaming](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/play): Browser-based cloud gaming for supported titles and devices.
- [Xbox Series X](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/consoles/xbox-series-x): Console product page with hardware details and capabilities.
- [Xbox Series S](https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/consoles/xbox-series-s): Compact Xbox console page with specs and digital-first gaming.
- [Xbox Support](https://support.xbox.com/en-CA/): Official support for Xbox consoles, accounts, subscriptions, and troubleshooting.

## AI and Copilot
- [Copilot](https://copilot.microsoft.com/): Consumer Copilot experience for AI chat, answers, and assistance.
- [Microsoft Copilot](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/microsoft-copilot): Product overview for Copilot experiences across Microsoft services.
- [Copilot Pro](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/store/b/copilotpro): Subscription offering for enhanced Copilot features and usage.
- [Copilot in Windows](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows/copilot-ai-features): Windows AI features and Copilot-related PC experiences.
- [Copilot+ PCs](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/windows/copilot-plus-pcs): New Windows PC category designed for on-device AI workloads.

## Cloud and Developer
- [Azure](https://azure.microsoft.com/en-ca/): Cloud platform for infrastructure, AI, data, security, and application services.
- [Azure Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/): Technical documentation for Azure services, deployment, and operations.
- [Azure Architecture Center](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/architecture/): Reference architectures, design patterns, and best practices for Azure solutions.
- [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/): Central documentation and training hub for Microsoft products and developer tools.
- [Microsoft Developer](https://developer.microsoft.com/): Developer portal for tools, platforms, APIs, and community resources.
- [Microsoft Graph Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/): API documentation for Microsoft 365 data, identity, and integrations.
- [Azure REST API Reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/azure/): Reference documentation for Azure management and service APIs.

## Support and Learning
- [Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us): Main support portal for Microsoft products, services, and troubleshooting.
- [Microsoft 365 Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365): Help articles and setup guidance for Microsoft 365 apps and subscriptions.
- [Windows Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows): Windows help, troubleshooting, and update assistance.
- [Surface Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/surface): Support content for Surface setup, repairs, and device troubleshooting.
- [Xbox Support](https://support.xbox.com/en-CA/): Xbox help for hardware, accounts, billing, and gameplay issues.
- [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/): Official learning paths, documentation, and technical training across Microsoft products.

## Store and Business
- [Microsoft Store](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/store/): Shopping portal for software, devices, subscriptions, and accessories.
- [Deals](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/store/b/sale): Promotional offers on Microsoft devices, software, and accessories.
- [Small Business Store](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/store/b/business): Business shopping hub for devices, software, and deployment support.
- [Business Solutions Hub](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/business): Microsoft business products for productivity, security, and collaboration.
- [Microsoft Teams](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/microsoft-teams/group-chat-software): Collaboration platform for organizations, meetings, and communication.
- [Microsoft 365 for Business](https://www.microsoft.com/en-ca/microsoft-365/business): Business productivity plans with collaboration, security, and device management.

## News and Company
- [Microsoft News](https://news.microsoft.com/): Official company news, announcements, product updates, and executive communications.
- [Microsoft Blog](https://blogs.microsoft.com/): Corporate blog covering technology, policy, AI, and product stories.
- [Investor Relations](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/Investor): Financial reports, filings, events, and shareholder information.
- [About Microsoft](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/about): Company overview, mission, leadership, and corporate information.
- [Careers](https://careers.microsoft.com/): Job listings, hiring information, and career opportunities at Microsoft.
- [Sustainability](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/sustainability): Microsoft's sustainability commitments, reporting, and environmental initiatives.
